ideas.name: PerkProof
ideas.niche: Influencer PR-Gifting ROI Tracking & Negotiation CRM
ideas.problem: Creators struggle to quantify the impact of gifted products, leaving them unable to prove value to brands and making it difficult to convert product-only relationships into lucrative paid contracts.
ideas.targetUser: Micro and mid-tier content creators (10k-500k followers) in lifestyle, beauty, and tech niches who receive consistent PR packages but lack the data to leverage them for paid work.
coreFeatures: Digital PR Inventory (MSRP & Brand Tracking)
Post-to-Product Linking (Syncing social content to specific items)
Automated ROI Analytics Dashboard (Reach, Engagement, & Estimated Value)
Brand Value Scorecard (Rating brands on product quality vs. engagement)
One-Click Negotiation Pitch Deck Generator
realDependencies: Instagram Graph API
TikTok for Developers API
Amazon/Google Shopping API for product valuation
Cloudinary for media storage
ideas.emulationStrategy: The demo will implement a 'Mock Data Engine' using a local JSON repository of realistic influencer data. All data fetching will be wrapped in an async/await wrapper that injects random delays (500ms-2000ms) to mimic real-world API latency. A 'Simulated Drift' function will slightly adjust engagement numbers on each refresh to simulate live social activity. Error states (401/429) will be triggered via a probability toggle to showcase UI resilience. The PDF export feature will use a client-side template engine to populate static layouts with the mock data, creating a high-fidelity visual illusion of real report generation.

ideas.name: BondNexus
ideas.niche: Chemical compatibility and adhesive selection for mixed-media prop construction.
ideas.problem: Material failure and structural collapses caused by improper adhesive selection or chemical reactions (e.g., solvents melting 3D prints or contact cement failing to bond to low-surface-energy plastics).
ideas.targetUser: Cosplayers, film prop builders, and theater technical crews (ages 16-45) who manage high-budget, multi-material builds involving EVA foam, resins, thermoplastics, and various adhesives.
coreFeatures: Interactive Compatibility Matrix: A searchable grid that provides 'Pass/Caution/Fail' ratings for any two material pairings.
Project Build Planner: A workflow tool where users input their intended materials, and the app flags potential bonding failures before assembly begins.
Solvent Sensitivity Library: A database of adhesives cross-referenced with material degradation risks (e.g., alerting that Toluene-based glues will warp certain PLA/resin prints).
Layering Logic Simulator: A tool to visualize the sequence of assembly to ensure secondary adhesives do not react poorly with primary bond layers.
realDependencies: Relational Database (PostgreSQL) for complex material-to-chemical mapping
Full-text Search API (Algolia) for rapid material lookup
Cloud Storage (Firebase/AWS) for user-saved project blueprints
User Authentication (Auth0) for multi-device project syncing
ideas.emulationStrategy: The demo will implement a 'MockDataProvider' service that intercepts all data requests. It will use a local JSON manifest containing 50+ pre-defined material/adhesive objects. To simulate real network conditions, every 'fetch' will be wrapped in a Promise that uses a randomized `setTimeout` between 500ms and 1500ms. For error handling demonstration, a 'Chaos Mode' toggle will be included, which causes the Mock API to return a 500 error on 10% of requests, allowing for testing of loading states and error toast notifications.

ideas.name: ChromaTrace
ideas.niche: Digital dye-chemistry and batch documentation for textile and fiber artists.
ideas.problem: Inconsistent color replication caused by unrecorded fluctuations in pH, water quality, mordant ratios, and fiber types, which leads to wasted materials and inability to fulfill repeat orders with identical shades.
ideas.targetUser: Professional yarn dyers, boutique textile studios, and small-scale fiber artists who sell color-critical products (like hand-dyed wool or silk) and need to maintain strict brand color standards across production runs.
coreFeatures: Batch Recipe Builder: Detailed logging of dye weight, mordant type, water pH, temperature, and immersion time.
Visual Swatch Library: High-resolution photo documentation paired with extracted Hex/RGB metadata for side-by-side comparison.
Consistency Delta Tool: A comparison engine that flags deviations between a current batch's chemical parameters and a stored 'Master Batch' reference.
Variable Impact Log: A data-driven timeline that tracks how specific changes (e.g., a change in water hardness) affected the final shade.
realDependencies: Cloud Object Storage (AWS S3) for high-resolution swatch image hosting
Relational Database (PostgreSQL) for complex chemical and recipe relationships
Computer Vision API (Google Vision or custom TensorFlow model) for automated color extraction
Auth0 or Firebase Auth for secure user profile and studio management
ideas.emulationStrategy: The demo will utilize an in-memory JavaScript object to act as a mock database, with all CRUD operations wrapped in async functions using `setTimeout` to simulate realistic network latency (500ms to 1.5s). Image uploads will be faked by converting local files to Base64 strings stored in the component state. The 'Color Extraction API' will be emulated via a lookup function that maps specific mock filenames to predefined Hex/RGB values, simulating a successful AI color analysis without actual processing.

The 'AI analysis' will be faked by triggering a 'thinking' animation followed by an immediate return of the hardcoded semantic data, providing a seamless and error-free demonstration of the end-state value.

ideas.name: NegaLens
ideas.niche: AI Prompt Engineering Optimization & Negative Prompt Auditing
ideas.problem: The 'Negative Prompt Failure' loop, where artists waste time and credits testing whether specific negative keywords actually influence model output or are being ignored by the latent space, leading to inconsistent visual quality.
ideas.targetUser: Professional digital concept artists, commercial prompt engineers, and high-volume AI illustrators who require repeatable, high-fidelity outputs across multiple foundational models like SDXL, Flux, and Midjourney.
coreFeatures: Cross-Model A/B Testing Suite: Run identical positive prompts with varying negative weights across multiple model checkpoints simultaneously.
The 'Negation Score' Metric: A proprietary visual analysis tool that quantifies how effectively a negative prompt actually suppressed unwanted elements.
Categorized Prompt Vault: A searchable, version-controlled library of 'clean' negative strings optimized for specific categories (e.g., Anatomy, Lighting, Text, Style).
Visual Difference (Diff) Overlay: A side-by-side comparison tool that uses transparency sliders to visually isolate exactly what the negative prompt removed from the composition.
realDependencies: Stable Diffusion/ComfyUI API via Fal.ai or Replicate
Midjourney API wrappers
AWS S3 for high-resolution image storage
OpenCV or CLIP-based vision models for automated visual effectiveness scoring
ideas.emulationStrategy: The demo will implement a 'Mock API Layer' that intercepts all requests. Instead of real generation, it will query a local JSON manifest containing a 'Golden Dataset' of pre-defined image pairs (one with the negative prompt, one without). To simulate inference, a 'Simulated Latency Engine' will trigger a progress bar with a randomized delay between 3 to 8 seconds. The 'Negation Score' will be calculated using a deterministic pseudo-random function: it will take the string length of the user's prompt and map it to a score between 0.0 and 1.0 to ensure 'consistent' fake results during a single session.
